title: Potential Temperature and Potential Vorticity Inversion
exact_target: Determine how inversion from potential temperature complements the more usual inversion from potential vorticity.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30001530 (OWR-4415-003). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Theory and Modelling in Atmosphere-Ocean-Science (2010), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2010/34, pp. 2027--2099; official report source and mathematical context.
Official EMS Press PDF of the same Oberwolfach report; PDF pages 18--19, printed pages 2044--2045.

status_qualification: Complementarity concerns information and diagnostic interpretation under consistent balance and boundary assumptions, not unconditional unique recovery from either scalar field. The report's simplest PT inversion uses hydrostatic integration with a boundary condition; the boundary information cannot be discarded.
